rows: Persistent SQL tables backed by an Oxigraph RDF dataset. Supports SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CREATE/DROP TABLE, schemas, RETURNING, defaults, NOT NULL, primary/unique keys and immediate foreign keys. Native SQL runs in the host engine; data and table definitions persist as RDF. Transactions use immutable snapshots and reject concurrent writer conflicts. Attach with database set to a durable directory, or omit it for a temporary database. Query the same data as typed SQL rows or RDF terms using local read-only SPARQL and bounded graph traversal. Stable resource identities connect the two query models. Foreign keys produce transactional resource-to-resource RDF edges. The backend enforces CHECK constraints, but the tested SQL engines cannot send native CHECK definitions.

rows.vgi.doc_md:
## RDF database worker

Persistent SQL tables backed by an Oxigraph RDF dataset. Supports SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CREATE/DROP TABLE, schemas, RETURNING, defaults, NOT NULL, primary/unique keys and immediate foreign keys. Native SQL runs in the host engine; data and table definitions persist as RDF. Transactions use immutable snapshots and reject concurrent writer conflicts. Attach with database set to a durable directory, or omit it for a temporary database. Query the same data as typed SQL rows or RDF terms using local read-only SPARQL and bounded graph traversal. Stable resource identities connect the two query models. Foreign keys produce transactional resource-to-resource RDF edges. The backend enforces CHECK constraints, but the tested SQL engines cannot send native CHECK definitions.

SQL data and definitions live in an Oxigraph dataset. The database directory contains immutable committed generations and private transaction workspaces. Commit publishes a complete generation; rollback discards private writes.
